description: The default/1 react palette of lessdugin (docs/spec/social.md §9). Normative for the fold: the set of `id` values. Presentation defaults (clients SHOULD use them and MAY localise them): `label`, `description`, `glyph`, `group`, the order of `groups` and the order of `reacts`.

reacts.label: Agreed
reacts.description: I agree with this.

reacts.label: Disagree
reacts.description: I disagree with this.

reacts.label: Important
reacts.description: This is important and deserves attention.

reacts.label: Insightful
reacts.description: This contains a useful new insight.

reacts.label: Changed my mind
reacts.description: This changed my mind.

reacts.label: Crux
reacts.description: This is a crux: my view on the question depends on it.

reacts.label: Not a crux
reacts.description: My view would not change if this were otherwise.

reacts.label: Locally valid
reacts.description: This step of reasoning is valid, whether or not I accept its premises or its conclusion.

reacts.label: Locally invalid
reacts.description: This step of reasoning does not follow, whether or not its conclusion is true.

reacts.label: Typo
reacts.description: There is a spelling, grammar or formatting mistake here.

reacts.label: Wrong
reacts.description: I think this is factually wrong.

reacts.label: Misleading
reacts.description: This is likely to leave readers with a false impression, even if it is literally true.

reacts.label: Unclear
reacts.description: This is hard to follow or ambiguous.

reacts.label: I don't understand
reacts.description: I could not follow this; please explain.

reacts.label: Examples?
reacts.description: Concrete examples would help here.

reacts.label: Citation needed
reacts.description: Please give a source for this claim.

reacts.label: Concrete
reacts.description: This is usefully concrete and specific.

reacts.label: Overconfident
reacts.description: This sounds more certain than the evidence warrants.

reacts.label: Underconfident
reacts.description: This sounds less certain than the evidence warrants.

reacts.label: Hits the mark
reacts.description: This gets right to the heart of the matter.

reacts.label: Missed the point
reacts.description: This does not engage with what was actually said.

reacts.label: Strawman
reacts.description: This presents the view it responds to as weaker than it is.

reacts.label: Steelman
reacts.description: This presents the opposing view in its strongest form.

reacts.label: Scout mindset
reacts.description: This is curious and seeks the truth.

reacts.label: Soldier mindset
reacts.description: This reads as defending a side rather than seeking the truth.

reacts.label: Too harsh
reacts.description: The tone here is harsher than it needs to be.

reacts.label: Good point
reacts.description: This is a good point.

reacts.label: Thanks
reacts.description: Thank you for this.

reacts.label: Seen
reacts.description: I have read this.

reacts.label: Will reply later
reacts.description: I intend to respond to this later.

reacts.label: Haha
reacts.description: This made me laugh.

reacts.label: Heart
reacts.description: I love this.

reacts.label: Surprised
reacts.description: This surprised me.

reacts.label: Empathy
reacts.description: I feel for you.
